title: Kasmina | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Kasmina, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Subtle, secretive, and deceptively powerful, Kasmina is a mysterious Planeswalker whose visions of the future warn of dark days ahead for the Multiverse. For years she has worked behind the scenes, influencing events across countless planes in hopes of averting apocalypse. Kasmina believes that no price is too high if it helps prevent the future she has foreseen.
